explanation: This norm-3.3 vector opposes the residual direction shared by the middle-layer LoRA attention-output and MLP-down updates, with its sign and secondary components informed by the gate/up factors. I refined it where two weight-only estimates agreed: the mean SwiGLU drift from Gaussian moment contractions and a downstream LoRA direction pulled back through analytic layer sensitivities. Injected after block 12 (zero-based), it gave the highest medical recovery on the practice batch (+0.4592) while also improving general recovery (+0.3459).
